# Acceptance Criteria

## Task ID

- [ ] Functional behavior is implemented.
- [ ] Focused tests pass.
- [ ] Required integration tests pass.
- [ ] Determinism/conservation checks pass when relevant.
- [ ] No architecture-boundary violations.
- [ ] Documentation is updated for contract changes.
- [ ] Benchmark evidence is recorded for hot-path changes.
- [ ] UI tasks include visual/accessibility evidence where relevant.
